about.title: About k399game
about.description: k399game is the first platform dedicated exclusively to games that are 100% generated by artificial intelligence. We believe AI can create unique, surprising, and endlessly creative gaming experiences. Every game here was born from prompts — no human wrote a single line of game code.
about.whatWeDoDesc: We source, curate, and showcase the best AI-generated games from cutting-edge models like Claude, GPT-4, and Gemini. Our future roadmap includes allowing creators to submit their own AI-generated games.
about.howItWorksDesc: Each game is generated by sending creative prompts to AI models. The AI writes complete, playable HTML5 games. We review, categorize, and publish the best ones on our platform — all instantly playable in your browser.
